info.title: OMR Engine API
info.description: Read OMR sheets (bubbles, barcodes, QR codes, OCR, ICR), manage templates, run bulk jobs and review uncertain reads.

post.description:
Change values (typed, or by toggling bubbles). The server recomputes the
field value (multi-marks in sheet order), custom-label outputs, score and
status; every change is an audit record.
A person checked every value of this sheet (feeds the accuracy readout).

Re-read the original file with template/config overrides. apply=false
returns a preview (overlay + changed values); apply=true stores the new
read (the previous one is kept in result.history).

get.description: Every manual change (who, when, old/new/original value), newest first.
Folder prefix rewrites used to find moved input files.

post.description: Read one sheet with the (unsaved) template; return its geometry to draw.
Run on every sample; list the blocks whose border was not found.

get.description:
view=original: the colour scan with every outline mapped back through
the recorded page transform (map: fields -> {box, bubbles: {value:
quad}}, zones -> quad, blocks -> {corners, status}; quads in image
pixels, TL TR BR BL). view=color: the aligned page in full colour
(same coordinates as /render). Nothing is re-detected.
Starting points of the folder picker: drives, or the allowed folders.
Sub-folders of a server folder with the images and PDFs directly in each.
ok, images and pdfs for a pasted path, or a plain error message.

delete.description:
Delete one scan: its result, stored images and uploaded copy. The
original file of a server-folder job is left alone. An audit record
(kind "delete") keeps who deleted what and when.

get.description:
Pending items under the queue filters, per field/zone name (for the
name filter, which ignores the name filter itself), and how many were
queued since a time. "now" is the server time to pass as since next.

parameters.name: since

schema.description: Also count items queued after this server time
schema.title: Since

parameters.description: Also count items queued after this server time

post.description:
For each queue item: "pending", "done" (with who decided it, when and
the value) or "gone" (the scan was deleted or regraded). The queue
screen uses it to skip items someone else already decided.

Accept every pending item under the filters as read (their values stay
as the engine read them). Nothing is deleted: each item is settled with
who accepted it and when (review_log action "bulk_accepted", plus an
audit record per item), so it can be traced and changed later. No
training samples are written for these unchecked values.

get.description: OCR engines available on this server, installed languages, defaults.
The saved crop of an image zone (student photo, signature).

post.description: Rows of a CSV or Excel (.xlsx) answer key; the GUI maps the columns.

Copy the template, config, answer key (evaluation.json) and reference
image into a new layout. Scans and results stay with the original.
Change the display name; the id stays, so jobs and results stay linked.
Mark the generator's warnings and verification list as checked, for good.

Check template.json, config.json and evaluation.json with the engine's
own rules, without saving. Returns {template, config, evaluation}: lists
of {path, message}; engine errors go to the file they most likely belong to.
Read one sheet with the saved template; nothing is stored.
Score one sheet's responses with a draft evaluation.json (not saved).
Find the timing marks inside a box drawn over a strip of marks.
The printed mark under a click (or inside a box): an index point.
Turn a printed box into a field block (bubble grid found inside it).

Re-run the saved template's alignment on the sample sheets kept from
generation: per sheet, the status, the marks matched and the index
points found, read on the aligned page the engine produced.
Confirm (clear) generator warnings; they stay listed as confirmed.

Export a job's (filters.job_id) or any Results filter's sheets as CSV,
XLSX, PDF, a SQLite file or into a database (format=sql + sql_url).
Runs in the background unless wait=true; poll GET /exports/{id}.
Columns, warnings and the first rows a profile produces.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Items handled by this call (repeat while remaining > 0)

expected.title: Expected
expected.description: The pending count the user confirmed; refused (409) when more items are pending now, so nothing unseen is accepted

before.title: Before
before.description: Only items queued at or before this server time (the 'now' of the /review/counts the user confirmed), so later arrivals stay pending

sample.title: Sample
sample.description: Sample name, or 'reference' (default) for the reference image

template.title: Template
template.description: Unsaved template.json from the editor (default: the saved one)

image.title: Image
image.description: Include the aligned page as a data URL

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: CSV or .xlsx: a file-name column (any spelling, e.g. 'File Name') plus one column per field; answer strings expand to q1..qN

files.title: Files
files.description: template.json plus assets, or one .zip of the folder

value.title: Value
value.description: Bubble value to toggle, e.g. B

changes.title: Changes
changes.description: {name: new value} for fields, zones, custom labels (split over their columns) and cross-field checks (by check name or output column). Bubble field values are concatenated bubble values ('' = blank, 'AB' = multi-mark).

accept.title: Accept
accept.description: Names whose current value is right (settles their review item)

toggle.title: Toggle
toggle.description: Bubbles to flip; the field value is recomputed server-side

view.title: View
view.description: all, flagged, reviewed, not_reviewed, corrected, errors

format.title: Format
format.description: csv, xlsx, pdf, sqlite or sql

wait.title: Wait
wait.description: Run in the request and return when done

box.title: Box
box.description: [x, y, w, h] of a drawn box

scan_id.title: Scan Id
scan_id.description: Use the stored responses of this scan instead

apply.title: Apply
apply.description: false: preview only; true: replace the stored read

keep_corrections.title: Keep Corrections
keep_corrections.description: Re-apply manual corrections on top of the new read

use_current_template.title: Use Current Template
use_current_template.description: Use the template as it is now instead of the version the sheet was read with

corrections.title: Corrections
corrections.description: {field_or_zone_name: corrected_value}. Field values are concatenated bubble values ('' = blank, 'AB' = multi-mark).

accept.title: Accept
accept.description: Names whose current value is correct

keep.title: Keep
keep.description: Colours that must stay dark (default: black, pencil, blue pens)

template.title: Template
template.description: template.json to check (default: the saved one)

config.title: Config
config.description: config.json to check (default: the saved one)

evaluation.title: Evaluation
evaluation.description: evaluation.json to check (default: the saved one)

clear.title: Clear
clear.description: Files to treat as absent, e.g. ["evaluation"] when it was emptied

engine.description: Also build the engine (overlaps, groups, assets)
